question: Should ai& be accepted as a permanent built-in CodexBar provider based on its documented spend API and coding-agent integrations?
rationale: The patch adds a user-facing provider ID, credential setting, documentation surface, and ongoing maintenance obligation; technical correctness cannot establish that product commitment.

options.title: Sponsor built-in support
options.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after successful funded-account proof and changelog cleanup.

options.title: Decline bundled support
options.body: Keep ai& outside the permanent provider registry unless adoption or maintenance capacity later changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in support
recommendation.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after successful funded-account proof and changelog cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the person visibly deciding provider scope, steipete is the best available owner for this inclusion choice.
